name: The Residences at The Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Pacific Place
short_description: Luxury serviced residences managed by The Ritz-Carlton at the Pacific Place complex in SCBD — apartment-style, one-to-three-bedroom units built for extended and long-stays, distinct from the adjacent Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Pacific Place hotel.
ai_summary: The Residences at The Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Pacific Place is a set of luxury serviced apartments managed by The Ritz-Carlton within the Pacific Place complex in SCBD (the Sudirman Golden Triangle), South Jakarta. This is a distinct property from the neighbouring Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Pacific Place hotel: it offers roughly 139 apartment-style residences in one-, two- and three-bedroom layouts (about 80-91 sqm for one-bedrooms and around 133 sqm for two-bedrooms), each with full kitchens and cookware, washer/dryer, walk-in wardrobes, private balconies and floor-to-ceiling skyline windows — a format aimed at extended and long-stay guests and families rather than short leisure trips. Independent coverage is limited and OTA-skewed: the standalone TripAdvisor Residences listing carries roughly a 4/5 rating with few reviews, while Booking.com shows about 9.0 from ~283 verified reviews. Recurring praise centres on spacious value-for-money units, the discreet-yet-attentive service and the unbeatable location with direct access to Pacific Place Mall and Istora MRT. The main watch-out is service inconsistency at check-in — reports of rooms not ready by 3pm and thin onboarding on WiFi/breakfast details.

core_facts.address: Jalan Jenderal Sudirman Kav 52-53, Sudirman Central Business District (SCBD), South Jakarta 12190, Indonesia
elite_benefits: Room upgrades for Platinum Elite and above, subject to availability
Complimentary breakfast or bonus points for Platinum Elite and above, per Marriott Bonvoy program terms
Guaranteed room availability with 24-hour notice for Titanium and Ambassador Elite

pros: Spacious apartment-style units (full kitchen, washer/dryer, walk-in wardrobe, balcony) ideal for families and long stays
Prime SCBD location with direct access to Pacific Place Mall and Istora MRT (~0.3 km)
Ritz-Carlton service standards with strong value-for-money for the space
Floor-to-ceiling skyline views from higher floors
cons: Service can be inconsistent at check-in — reports of rooms not ready by 3pm and limited onboarding info
Limited independent (non-OTA) review coverage, so guest sentiment is harder to verify
Long-stay/apartment format less suited to a short one-night leisure trip
research_highlights: Distinct serviced-residences property (code JKTPR) separate from the Ritz-Carlton hotel (JKTRT) at the same Pacific Place complex
~139 one/two/three-bedroom apartments designed for extended stays, with full kitchens and laundry
Direct mall access and MRT proximity in the SCBD Golden Triangle
research_watchouts: Unit count varies by source (132 vs 139) and apartment sizes are not consistently published
Most available reviews are OTA/TripAdvisor aggregate and mix the Residences with the hotel; treat ratings cautiously

faqs.question: Is this the same as the Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Pacific Place hotel?
faqs.answer: No. The Residences (property code JKTPR) are luxury serviced apartments managed by The Ritz-Carlton, separate from the Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Pacific Place hotel (JKTRT), although both sit within the same Pacific Place complex in SCBD.

faqs.question: What kind of accommodation does it offer?
faqs.answer: Apartment-style serviced residences in one-, two- and three-bedroom layouts, with full kitchens and cookware, washer/dryer, walk-in wardrobes, private balconies and floor-to-ceiling skyline windows — geared to extended and long-stay guests and families.

faqs.question: How far is it from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport (CGK)?
faqs.answer: Roughly 25 km, about a 40-minute drive depending on Jakarta traffic.

faqs.question: What is nearby?
faqs.answer: It has direct access to Pacific Place Mall, is about 0.3 km from Istora MRT station, and sits beside the Indonesia Stock Exchange in the SCBD/Sudirman business district.
